## Scope and limits

The evaluated profile is one process, direct HTTPS/Cheroot and local SQLite/WAL. Real site deployment, broader infrastructure/platforms, all browser screens, durable workers and capacity are not certified. Mail and backup are best effort; audit export retains its existing cap.

The newly prepared GitHub community files are outside this frozen ZIP. GitHub's automatic source archives for a future tag are different artifacts; do not claim they share this asset's checksum or validation.
